purpose: Exact read-only reads that would supply the P07 declarations listed in QUALIFICATION_GAPS.md section 4 for option B (MOE/WMON forward 20-minute window). Nothing here was executed.

requires_new_capability.reason: No accepted tool runs these reads on a fixed schedule and saves hashed results. The application release allowlist is exactly eth_chainId and eth_getTransactionReceipt (operating_release.RPC_METHODS), and release facts freeze before a run.
requires_new_capability.scope_of_separate_packet: A reviewed, owner-run recorder that reads credential slots at run time, makes only the calls below, enforces each max_calls, never retries, and writes the outputs below plus request and response SHA-256 values. It must not import or change the application release path.

global_rules.credentials: Read at run time from the named slots only. No key, URL path secret or authorization header in any output, log, evidence or model input.
global_rules.chain_writes: None. No eth_sendRawTransaction, no signing, no wallet, no gas. eth_call is a read-only simulation.
global_rules.retries: None. A failed or refused call stops its phase and is recorded.
global_rules.pacing: At most 1 request per second per provider. Documented limits are higher: QuickNode Build 50 requests per second; HyperSync Starter 100 requests per minute (PUBLIC_DOC 2026-10-15). The account plans are unknown.
global_rules.outputs: Values, hashes, statuses, times and counts only. Raw responses stay in private evidence outside the repository.
global_rules.time_source: Recorder UTC clock for observation times. Block timestamps come from the replies. No time is invented or backfilled.

placeholders.T0: Window start, a five-minute grid UTC time chosen and recorded before P2 starts. NEEDS_APPROVAL.
placeholders.B_PRE: Number of the last block with timestamp < T0, from the P2 latest-block reads.
placeholders.B_START: Number of the first block with timestamp >= T0.
placeholders.B_END: Number of the last block with timestamp < WINDOW_END, from P3 pages.
placeholders.B_POST: Number of the first block with timestamp >= WINDOW_END, from P3 pages.
placeholders.POOL_CREATION_TX: The retained Probe A pool-creation transaction hash (private evidence C2-meme-flow-selection-03, moe-pool-creation-receipt). Publishing it is part of decision D7.
placeholders.FACTORY: The address that emitted the pool-creation event, read from the P1 receipt.
placeholders.CREATION_TOPIC0: topic0 of the pool-creation event in the P1 receipt. The fork may not use the canonical PairCreated topic 0x0d3648bd0f6ba80134a33ba9275ac585d9d315f0ad8355cddefde31afa28d0e9.

quicknode.host: NEEDS_FACT: host of the builder's QuickNode Monad endpoint

public_source_lookup.url: NEEDS_FACT: an explorer or verification service that publishes verified source for chain 143

contracts.selector_basis: Computed with the accepted keccak256 in docs/qualification/p07/qualification.py

evidence_requests: Builder states the QuickNode plan name and whether Monad archive state is included, without sharing the URL or key.
Builder states the Envio HyperSync plan name and its current rate limit.
Builder confirms T0 and the decisions in QUALIFICATION_GAPS.md section 7.
stop_if: Any decision in QUALIFICATION_GAPS.md section 7 items 2 to 4 is missing.

calls.supplies: pool_venue: the pool names the same factory

stop_if: receipt status is not success or the event does not name the pool
the HyperSync log differs from the receipt log in any identity field

phases.when: Starting at most 120 s before T0 and finished by T0 + 60 s

calls.supplies: B_PRE and B_START bounds; the second read is scheduled after T0, not a retry
pool_tokens source 1 at the window start

stop_if: any historical-state-unavailable or other JSON-RPC error: decimals stay NOT_READ
token0 or token1 differs from the retained order

phases.when: For each of the 4 buckets: first read at bucket end + 30 s, second read at bucket end + 120 s only if the first did not cover the bucket

params.from_block: <B_PRE for bucket 1, else the previous reply's next_block>

calls.supplies: delivery_records: bucket start -> first reply_received_at_utc whose blocks cover the bucket

stop_if: a bucket is still uncovered after its second read: that bucket has no delivery record and availability stays below QUALIFIED
log_count over the whole scan from B_PRE exceeds 61: complete corroboration is not reachable, so stop before P4 and report

phases.when: At WINDOW_END + 60 s or later, after P3
stop_if: finalized number < B_POST + 2: finality is NOT_OBSERVED; no repeated read
any decimals value differs from the P2 value

calls.method: GET verified source for the pool

params.data: <selector of a reflection-exclusion view named in the verified MOE source, applied to the pool address>

calls.conditional: Only when the verified source has such a view. Otherwise 0 calls.
calls.supplies: mechanics: whether the pair receives reflection

stop_if: no verified source matches the bytecode: fee_transfer_semantics stays unqualified
phases.after_calls: A written mechanics finding, reviewed like a document, plus a builder-approved definition of QUALIFIED mechanics. Reading code is not proof of runtime behavior.

totals.arithmetic: Sum of phase maxima. QuickNode P1 6 + P2 6 + P3 0 + P4 6 + P5 1 = 19. HyperSync P1 1 + P3 8 = 9. Public lookups P5 2. Credits 19 x 30 = 570.

declarations_supplied.pool_tokens: CORROBORATED_READ only if P1 receipt, P1 HyperSync log and P2 token0/token1 all agree
declarations_supplied.pool_venue: CORROBORATED only if the P1 receipt, the P1 HyperSync log and P1 factory() agree
declarations_supplied.decimals: window_start, window_end and current READ only for reads that returned without error
declarations_supplied.fee_transfer_semantics: QUALIFIED only after P5 evidence and decision D5
declarations_supplied.finality_at_collection: OBSERVED_FINAL only if P4 finalized number >= B_POST + 2
declarations_supplied.delivery_records: One entry per bucket covered in P3; a bucket without one stays undelivered
declarations_supplied.archive_height: P4 latest number, only if >= B_POST + 2
declarations_supplied.collected_at_utc: The P4 finalized read time, if decision D3 accepts it; not earlier than WINDOW_END

not_supplied: Account rights, plan, price or retention: these are evidence requests in P0 and OPERATING_PACKET.md section 6.
Nansen coverage of MOE: only an actual Nansen reply can show it; see OPERATING_PACKET.md section 4.
Any history page, receipt or verdict for the application run.
decision_ids: D1 to D10 are defined in OPERATING_PACKET.md section 9.
